about_the_game:
Learning to Bear

A surreal, chaotic journey through existence, stuckness, and the absurd.

You wake up as Bearden, a bear with no clear purpose or path — just the will to change something.
Dropped into a world that doesn’t explain itself. That’s where the game begins.
Or maybe it already began. Or maybe it never really ends.

It’s about bearing.

Not knowing. Getting stuck.
Questioning the point — and doing it anyway.
It’s about feeling like you’ve been thrown into something you didn’t choose — like life — and somehow finding a way to move through it.

There’s no tutorial. No guiding hand.
You’ll find things. You’ll miss things. You’ll make mistakes.
But maybe that’s part of the experience.
Maybe that is the experience.

Built from scratch over two years.

Every mistake left in. Every strange choice embraced.
Weird. Surreal. Raw.

This game comes from the same place it tries to reflect:
A world full of bearing — but one you have to navigate anyway.

Explore a world of strange puzzles, abstract logic, and melancholic riddles.
Uncover meaning. Or don't. Just try to bear it.


🛠️ Level Editor in development

Soon, you'll be able to build your own puzzles using Learning to Bear’s unique logic.
Mix what you've learned. Expand the absurd. Challenge others. Reflect your own chaos.

This is the first era of Learning to Bear — the raw, pure chaos.

There’s no studio behind this. Just a person, trying to make something that reflects the chaos of being thrown into the world and learning to move through it.

And while I feel like it doesn’t yet come close to what I imagine it could be, supporting me helps get it to where I can see it.

Thanks for being here.

Bear with me. 🐻

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 (2GB VRAM, DX12 support)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements can't cover all possible configurations. Performance may vary depending on your system.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (3GB+ VRAM, DX12 support)

short_description: Maneuver unique platforms to conquer 3D puzzles and score goals. Collect runes, decrypt ancient texts, and unlock powerful abilities in this strategy puzzle-action RPG. Soar in a wingsuit, swing, grind rails, and combat enemies as you face a mission filled with unique challenges and puzzles.
